faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How many yachts are in the database?
faq.q2: Can I compare yachts side by side?
faq.a2: Yes! Select up to 4 yachts from the browse page and click Compare to see specs side by side — length, displacement, sail area, cabins, and more.
faq.q3: Is the database free to use?
faq.a3: Yes, the Sailing Yacht Info is completely free for personal use and for organizations with annual revenue under $100,000.
faq.q4: Where does the data come from?
faq.a4: Specifications are sourced from manufacturer brochures, official documentation, and verified owner contributions.
